macro_events.event: Caterpillar Q2 Blowout — Stock +11%, Raised Revenue Guidance
macro_events.causal_chain: CAT beats Q2 and raises revenue guidance → stock +11% to $925 premarket → validates ongoing industrial capex cycle (infrastructure, data center construction, mining) → read-across to EMR (automation), PCAR (trucks), DE (ag machinery), ETN (electrical) → industrial sector rotation ▲. CAT's revenue raise implies forward orders remain robust → procurement cycle continues.
macro_events.historical_analog: CAT's April 2024 earnings beat triggered a 3-week rally in industrials (XLI +4%). Industrial bellwethers typically set sector tone for 2-3 weeks post-earnings.
macro_events.counterargument: CAT's strength may be idiosyncratic (large project wins, backlog execution) rather than reflective of broad industrial demand. Also, +11% leaves CAT itself extended for new entries — the trade is the read-across names.

macro_events.event: AMD Earnings — 50% Revenue Growth Not Enough, -7%
macro_events.causal_chain: AMD Q2 revenue +50% YoY to $11.5B, EPS $1.66 (beat), but guidance failed to deliver Helios-driven blowout → stock -7% → capex surged to $808M from $282M (investors question ROI) → Elon Musk announces SpaceX builds exclusively with Nvidia chips → sentiment shifts: AI capex boom benefits Nvidia disproportionately → KOSPI -4% as Samsung/SK Hynix fall 8% (global AI sentiment contagion). The lesson: the bar for AI beneficiaries is now 'exceptional, not good.'
macro_events.historical_analog: Meta's February 2024 earnings — revenue +25% but stock fell 5% initially before recovering when AI investment thesis re-established. High-expectation misses can be temporary if the secular trend holds.
macro_events.counterargument: AMD's actual numbers were strong (revenue +50%, operating income +245%). The sell-off may be a buying opportunity once the Helios narrative clarifies. Broadcom guidance of 200%+ AI revenue growth validates the broader AI demand story.

macro_events.event: Eli Lilly Q2 Revenue +48% — Obesity Drug Juggernaut
macro_events.causal_chain: LLY Q2 revenue $23B (+48% YoY) → Mounjaro sales +91% to $9.9B, Zepbound +44% to $4.9B → raised full-year guidance to $85-87B → stock +5% on RVOL 2.1 → validates GLP-1 market is still in hyper-growth phase → supply chain beneficiaries (CDMO partners, injection device makers) benefit. Bloomberg floats stock split possibility.
macro_events.historical_analog: NVO's November 2024 earnings triggered a 2-week healthcare sector rally. Large-cap pharma beats with raised guidance typically see 3-5 sessions of post-earnings drift.
macro_events.counterargument: LLY at $1,170 prices in enormous growth. Competition from oral GLP-1s (Roche, Pfizer pipeline) could erode share over 12-18 months. Insurance coverage expansion may plateau. Valuation is the risk, not the fundamentals.
